params.caption: 🕹️ Death Stranding 2 leads November's PS Plus Game Catalog Sony has revealed the next batch of PlayStation Plus Game Catalog titles: 10 games in total, arriving from November 11, with some rolling out later in the month in the US and UK. Hideo Kojima's Death Stranding 2: On the Beach is the headliner. Sony is also retiring the PlayStation Plus app for PC, ending PC streaming in December. 🕒 Nov 10, 2026 · 19:36 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: GameSpot #PSPlus #DeathStranding2 #GamingNews
